description: Unit (helper): returns the given status and a relative Location for a path with query and fragment; merges request query parameters without overriding existing ones; passes extra headers through.
Unit (helper): rejects 'https://evil.example', '//evil.example', '/\\evil.example' and a path without a leading slash.

Unit (productNavDispatcher): with a request whose nextUrl origin is http://localhost:3000, /msp/go/mailbox, /msp/go/providers and /msp/go/calendar answer 307 with a relative Location for each product (psa, algadesk, co_managed), keep incoming query parameters, send Cache-Control: no-store, and unknown targets 404.
Unit: the OpenAPI metadata redirect, the mobile handoff sign-in redirect and the Teams auth callback redirect return a Location that does not contain the request's internal origin.
Unit (microsoftEmailSetupCallback): the admin consent callback's return redirect resolves to the provider setup page without an internal origin when the request origin is http://localhost:3000.

Contract: scanning route handlers and controllers finds no redirect built from request.nextUrl.origin, req.url or an origin derived from them outside the allow-list; a fixture with the old go-route code makes the test fail.
Unit (authorizationMiddleware): the unauthorised redirect targets the resolved public origin when forwarded-host trust is on and the request URL carries the internal origin.
